- Revenue fell 21.8% YoY  
- Single shareholder holds 56.47%

**Overview**  
Sinar Sinar Pelancongan Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited hospitality firm that runs a boutique hotel in Kuching. It was incorporated on 17 January 1998 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. The company has three directors, with a single shareholder owning 56.47% of the equity, and is currently in winding‑up status.
